messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — kicking off handoff for the heterogenous samplebank we'll use for the new-model bring-up + quant smoke. Need alignment on dedupe, golden allocation, and labeling rubric before we open batches.

ajay: thanks — can you list the upstream sources one more time? want to check overlap with old seedbank.

mira: sources: prod-logs (anonymized), synth-harvest v2, user-feedback-curated, partner-drops (legal cleared). also a small legacy bank from early pilots.

cameron: re: dedupe — propose we run fingerprint + fuzzy-title dedupe. prototype command i ran yesterday:
```
python tools/dedupe.py --src heterog_bank --fingerprint sha256 --fuzzy 0.85 --keep-meta --out dedup/round1.jsonl
```
results looked sane but reduced examples in some rare intents a lot. :thinking_face:

sasha: we need to reserve a golden slice for edge-case regressions. suggestion: 150 total golden, split 60 intent-edge, 60 hallucination/counterfactual, 30 multilingual edge covers. keep them out of dedupe so they survive.

devon: +1 on keeping gold out. also caution: overly aggressive dedupe (0.9+) removed paraphrase clusters that are useful for quant regressions. for quant experiments we want some near-duplicates to see fidelity impact. recommend fuzzy 0.85 for main bank, but provide a "near-dup" bucket we keep for eval.

tess: plan for quant smoke: run v3-fp16 and v3-int8 on a 2k random sample + the near-dup bucket. compare accuracy, hallucination rate, and token-cost delta. i'll write the runbook.

ajay: labeling rubric needs one update: add flag `context-mismatch` for examples where user intent can't be resolved from prompt alone. also mark `sensitive-personal-data` when applicable. put examples.

mira: drafted a minimal rubric snippet, will push to repo:
- accept/neutral/reject for response quality
- flags: context-mismatch, hallucination, PII, borderline-toxicity
- confidence 1-4
- annotation note (free text) mandatory for any flag

label-bot: New labeling batch created: SB-4712 (200 tasks) assigned to labelers: @labeling-team.

cameron: i'll run dedupe with 0.85 threshold and output both main and near-dup buckets tonight, push artifacts to s3://redwood-experiments/heterog_dedupe/2050123456/. i'll post summary tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

sasha: i'll seed the golden set from the edge-case pool and lock it (no dedupe). will create a small eval harness for golden checks and share permutations.

devon: when you run the quant smoke, capture logits so we can do mismatch attribution (top-k diff). also log batching config and kv cache sizes — those can affect perf/regressions.

tess: noted. also: small QA ask — can we hold out 200 examples for a cross-model benchmark ladder (internal reuse)? that would be separate from golden.

mira: yes — we'll carve out: 150 golden, 200 benchmark-ladder, rest into training/labeling. update sampler config tonight.

ajay: timeline? when do labelers start on SB-4712?

label-bot: Labelers accepted batch SB-4712 on 2050123500.

cameron: target: dedupe artifacts + s3 link by 2050123600.

sasha: golden seeds posted in the repo under eval/gold/heterog_2050123456.jsonl by EOD.

mira: action items summary —
- mira: push sampler config + rubric commit (will link)
- cameron: run dedupe 0.85 + produce near-dup bucket (artifacts to s3)
- sasha: seed & lock golden set; create golden eval harness
- tess: write quant smoke runbook and kick off runs after artifacts land
- ajay/devops: ensure labeler infra has the new flags enabled (context-mismatch, PII)

mira: i'll drop the repo PR here when ready. thanks everyone. :pray: :eyes:

cameron: quick log snippet i saved:
```
Dedup summary: input=24,312 out=18,901 near_dup=1,744 kept_gold=150
Top clusters reduced: onboarding-intent, password-reset-phrases, tiny-product-qa
```

mira: perfect — if anything blocks, ping me. otherwise we'll reconvene in tomorrow standup for quick checkpoints.

ajay: +1, thanks all.

label-bot: All tasks for SB-4712 queued.

sasha: posting the first golden preview now, tagging QA. :mag:
